Barbara Walters had a long career in journalism. She became co-host of the Today show in 1974 and later moved to ABC News. Her famous presidential interviews are well-documented, but I need to identify the *first* one.

Richard Nixon resigned in August 1974. Barbara Walters did interview Nixon, but this was actually in 1980, after he had left office - this was not her first presidential interview.

The first sitting US president Barbara Walters interviewed was actually Jimmy Carter in 1977, shortly after he took office. However, if we're asking about the first US president she interviewed (whether sitting or former), it could have been Nixon in 1980.
